This '''Mandalorian''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of [[Clan Spar]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He, along with [[Akaavi Spar]] were the last members of the clan. He was captured and executed by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] in [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] around [[3642 BBY]], leaving Akaavi as the sole survivor of the clan.
